tips.tipsSubtitle: 3 tips to nail your first message and get more responses
tips.startCasualDesc: Ask if it's the right number - keep it friendly, not salesy.
tips.noLinksFirstDesc: Wait for them to reply before sending any links or prices.
tips.followUpCloseDesc: 80% of deals happen after the 2nd message. Don't give up early.
tips.motivational: Consistency is everything - the people who send 10+ messages a day land clients within weeks, not months.

postContact.whenSomeoneRepliesDesc: — have a conversation, send a voice note. Then update their Status and set a Next Action like "Follow Up" so you never lose track.

outreachTips.tip1Desc: — The 'Initial Contact' template auto-rotates between 6 proven casual openers. Just hit send.
outreachTips.tip2Desc: — No links, images, or videos in your first message. Just be friendly and try to get a casual reply first.
outreachTips.tip3Desc: — If they don't have WhatsApp, try SMS. But the best option is to call — have a pitch ready using a pre-made script template.
outreachTips.tip4Desc: — Don't sell straight away. Ask a question, reference their business, and keep it natural.
